sections.value: pm-001, 2026-11-08 08:04: keep flagging normal sends held behind a busy turn for more than 15 minutes, to role:pm-001 --reply none, one line per round. Entries marked 'still queued' are undelivered; the others were delivered late. F113 (queued for kestrel): GPT Copilot seats (bobcat, ocelot, squirrel) were held 15 to 36 min with steer on; open question whether steering only lands at tool boundaries (a long cargo test holds a send) or it's a bug. Extension builds ed9a3d7 and 3ba582c are newer than cb0ce436 and include #152, so a seat on them does steer; don't flag those builds as off.
